component.name: TachoArchiv
component.summary: Read, archive and evaluate tachograph driver cards
Odczyt, archiwizacja i analiza kart kierowców
Прочитане, архивиране и анализ на карти на водача
Načítání, archivace a vyhodnocení karet řidičů

description.p: TachoArchiv reads first and second generation driver cards through any PC/SC card reader, stores the signed downloads unchanged as DDD files and checks driving times, breaks and rest periods according to Regulation (EC) 561/2006 as amended by the Mobility Package.
Available in German, English, Polish, Bulgarian and Czech.
